item.title: Polisario Front faces choices before UN vote
item.description: Tensions rise in Tindouf and Algiers over a new UN resolution framework for Western Sahara.

item.title: UN Security Council votes on MINURSO future

item.title: US revises Western Sahara resolution draft
item.description: Draft changes autonomy from 'only viable' to 'most viable' solution, adding self-determination conditions.

item.title: Lavrov and Attaf discuss Western Sahara in Moscow
item.description: Russian and Algerian foreign ministers met amid UN Security Council talks on a US draft resolution.
